capabilities: bind the vault to a Hyvmind account via a Principal ID
upload folders and notes to Hyvmind from the right-click menu
apply folder-level attributes and sources through _attributes.md and _sources.md files
download Hyvmind notes back into an Obsidian vault
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push folders and notes into Hyvmind's graph, where they can be edited and converted into extensible graphs.

relations.evidence: Right-click any folder and select 'Upload to Hyvmind'.

summary: Uploads vault folders and notes to Hyvmind, a legal knowledge app, after a one-time Principal ID binding.
